resources.string: Could not read the edited text
Two things must be switched on for live feedback while you type. Android only allows granting them from system settings, so each button opens the right page.
Live feedback is on — the panel appears while you type.
Live feedback is off — both grants below are needed.
Lets the small feedback panel float above whatever app you are writing in.

Lets the app read the text field you are typing in, which is the only way Android allows feedback inside other apps. Find "Hemingway" in the list and turn it on. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere — the app has no internet permission at all.
Reads the text field you are currently typing in so Hemingway can show readability feedback. Nothing is stored or transmitted; the app declares no internet permission.
Select text in most apps and choose Hemingway from the popup menu, or share it here. Apps that draw their own selection menu — Obsidian, for one — offer neither, so paste into the editor instead.
